channel.description: Latest articles from LP Gas magazine (lpgasmagazine.com)

item.title: Cargas acquires Silverline’s MyFuelPortal
item.description: The acquisition is of the MyFuelPortal customer engagement platform only and does not include Silverline’s hosting business or other managed IT services. <p>The post Cargas acquires Silverline’s MyFuelPortal first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: PERC partners with North American Council for Freight Efficiency
item.description: Tucker Perkins, president and CEO of PERC, will join the NACFE Advisory Board for close collaboration with industry leaders. <p>The post PERC partners with North American Council for Freight Efficiency first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: 2026 Propane Suppliers Guide
item.description: The Suppliers Guide is a directory of the propane industry’s top product sources. <p>The post 2026 Propane Suppliers Guide first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Metsa Tanks details underground propane solutions
item.description: At the 2025 LP Gas Growth Summit, Metsa Tanks explained how it aims to support the propane industry with underground tanks, monitored integration and pre-installed corrosion protection. <p>The post Metsa Tanks details underground propane solutions first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Energy Partners acquires 406 Propane
item.description: Energy Partners completed the first acquisition in company history with the purchase of 406 Propane, a neighboring propane retailer in Missoula, Montana. <p>The post Energy Partners acquires 406 Propane first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Jernigan Oil sells convenience retail division to Sunoco Retail
item.description: Matrix advised Jernigan Oil on the sale of its convenience retail division to Sunoco Retail, an affiliate of Sunoco LP. <p>The post Jernigan Oil sells convenience retail division to Sunoco Retail first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Lakes Gas expands Midwest footprint with Superior Gas Service acquisition
item.description: Superior Gas Service of Marshfield, Wisconsin, becomes Lakes Gas' 60th staffed location. <p>The post Lakes Gas expands Midwest footprint with Superior Gas Service acquisition first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Southern Quality Propane adds Woods Propane in North Florida expansion
item.description: Southern Quality Propane has acquired Woods Propane, expanding its presence in North Florida. <p>The post Southern Quality Propane adds Woods Propane in North Florida expansion first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: F.W. Webb becomes full-line distributor of RegO products
item.description: F.W. Webb Co. is expanding access to propane regulators by becoming a full-line distributor of RegO products. <p>The post F.W. Webb becomes full-line distributor of RegO products first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Mopeka highlights Cathodic Sentinel, Sentinel Plus at LP Gas Growth Summit
item.description: Mopeka explains how its Cathodic Sentinel and Sentinel Plus combine accurate tank monitoring with cathodic protection data to support safety, reliability and compliance for propane retailers during a sit-down at the 2025 LP Gas Growth Summit. <p>The post Mopeka highlights Cathodic Sentinel, Sentinel Plus at LP Gas Growth Summit first appeared on LP Gas.</p>
